caseName: Mastrobuono v. Shearson Lehman Hutton, Inc.
caseNameFull: Mastrobuono v. Shearson Lehman Hutton, Inc.

opinions.text: C. A. 7th Cir. Certiorari granted. Brief of petitioners is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Wednesday, November 16, 1994. Brief of respondents is to be filed with, the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Tuesday, December 13,1994. A reply brief, if any, is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Thursday, December 29, 1994. This Court’s Rule 29.2 does not apply.
